limitations: This qualifies forced retirement and replacement for two cold full-size typed finalizers on one RTX 5080; it does not establish throughput improvement.
The 768 MiB retained-arena pressure comes from a test-only C host fixture. Production allocator settings and the static library remain unchanged.
The reuse gate bounds reported System backing only at drained job boundaries. Sampled telemetry is not an RSS bound or complete worker lifetime admission.
Other caller/driver threads, cached thread storage, opaque/shared driver storage and overlapping worker/coordinator lifetimes still need enforced ownership bounds.
Ordinary workload admission remains closed for incomplete lifetime profiles.

All maintained proving families/routes, broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
